thread:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — cutting RC for v1.4 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need: version bump, final changelog entry, security signoff, QA smoke/regression, and docs spotcheck. Tagging owners: @Maria @Sam @Lina @Ajay
Maria: On it. I'll do the version bump and push the tag. Will also draft the changelog entry and link it here.
Sam: I'll take QA ownership — planning smoke at 06:30 PT and full regression starting 07:00 PT. Can we freeze branch by 08:30 PT?
Lina: Docs: I'll do a quick pass on the upgrade guide and the release notes once the changelog is finalized. Share PR when ready.
Maria: OK bump steps I'm going to run locally then push (will create release branch if needed):
```
# bump to rc
git checkout -b release/v1.4
git merge --no-ff main
npm version prerelease --preid=rc --no-git-tag-version
git commit -am "bump v1.4.0-rc1"
git tag v1.4.0-rc1
git push origin release/v1.4 --tags
```
Maria: Draft changelog snippet: "Fix: reduce inference memory spike during KV cache flush (regression from v1.3.2)." Thoughts?
Jordan: Good. Please add short repro steps in changelog for QA.
Ajay: SAST scan on main is green. Snyk shows 1 low vuln in a dev dependency — filed RED-834 to track, won't block RC. Link: https://snyk.io/org/redwood/project/123 :white_check_mark:
Sam: QA plan: smoke (core flows) 06:30-07:00, regression 07:00-08:30, quick performance sanity 08:30-08:50. If anything blocks, I'll post failures in this thread and tag owners.
Lina: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/432 — includes upgrade notes and callouts for kv cache change. I'll hold merge until changelog text is final.
Maria: Pushed tag and changelog draft at https://github.com/redwood/changelog/pull/210 — ping me for edits.
Jordan: Locking freeze at 08:30 PT (no merges to release/v1.4 after that except hotfixes with explicit signoff). If you need an exception, DM me. :lock:
Sam: Sounds good. Will post smoke results here.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed for build 789 — artifacts uploaded.
Maria: small note — PRs targeting release branch should include changelog label and QA checklist.
Lina: Spot-checked docs, minor wording tweak sent as review.
Ajay: Security quick checklist complete: SAST green, Snyk ticket filed, dependency policy reviewed.
Jordan: Thanks all — will open the RC cut ticket at 08:50 PT and do the final cut at 09:00 PT if no blockers. :rocket:
